_note: Reference buildings and tariffs for issue #28. economics.py runs the yearly balance for each building and writes packages/economics/src/buildings.json, which the map's building card imports. Areas are energy reference areas (EBF). Specific demand is for Basel's climate; climate_factor scales space heat for another place. Anything marked OUR GUESS has no outside source yet. Sources: docs/economics/README.md

basel_house.name: Reference house, Basel
basel_house.source: DigitalHeat case brief: the heating formula and 12 kWh hot water a day on Basel 2025 weather; no floor area.

bern_block.name: Flat block, Bern (1970s)
bern_block.source: Area: OUR GUESS of 8 flats of 102 m² (BFS, average occupied dwelling, 15 Sep 2026) plus stairs and walls. Space heat 100 kWh/m²: OUR GUESS within the BFE band of 120-150 kWh/m² for heat and hot water in buildings from before 1970. Hot water 21 kWh/m²: SIA 380/1 standard value for flats (Kanton Thurgau Energieordner, Tabelle 6). Climate: Bern-Zollikofen had 1.19 times Basel-Binningen's heating degree days in 2025 (HEV Schweiz, Heizgradtage). Tariff: ewb Bern not checked yet, so the Swiss 2027 median.

basel_office.name: Office building, Basel
basel_office.source: Area: OUR GUESS. Space heat 65 kWh/m²: OUR GUESS, twice the SIA 380/1:2016 new-build limit for offices (13 + 15 × 1.3 = 32.5 kWh/m², Kanton Zürich Anforderungsprofil), which is GEAK class D (GEAK-Kodifizierung 3.0, Tab. 41). Hot water 7 kWh/m²: SIA 380/1 standard value for offices (Kanton Thurgau Energieordner, Tabelle 6).

fhnw_dreispitz.name: FHNW Campus Dreispitz, HGK tower
fhnw_dreispitz.source: Hochbauamt Basel-Stadt project sheet, Jan 2016: energy reference area 10,176 m² (gross floor area 11,923 m²), heating demand Qh 53 MJ/m² = 14.7 kWh/m² (SIA 380/1 design value), Minergie-P-ECO. The 20,000 m² often quoted is the tower and the Zollfreilager next to it together (about 28,800 m² gross). Hot water 7 kWh/m²: SIA 380/1 standard value for schools (Kanton Thurgau Energieordner, Tabelle 6). It is in Basel-Landschaft, so IWB's tariff is OUR GUESS for its power.

iwb_h4_2026.name: IWB Basel 2026, households (H4)
iwb_h4_2026.source: ElCom, strompreis.elcom.admin.ch, Basel (2701), H4 total without VAT, checked 21 Nov 2026.

iwb_h4_2027.name: IWB Basel 2027, households (H4)
iwb_h4_2027.source: ElCom, strompreis.elcom.admin.ch, Basel (2701), H4 total without VAT, checked 21 Nov 2026. Matches IWB's own CHF 1,504 for 4,500 kWh (release of 25 Aug 2026).

iwb_c3_2027.name: IWB Basel 2027, business (C3)
iwb_c3_2027.source: ElCom, strompreis.elcom.admin.ch, Basel (2701), C3 total without VAT, checked 21 Nov 2026.

scaling.hardware: per server as in the reference house's hardware case, so fitting hours grow with the number of servers
scaling.jobs: the reference house's evening and batch jobs, plus the unlimited backlog
scaling.source: OUR GUESS: everything scales with heat demand or with the number of servers.
